adversarialFindings.description: Data-loss risk examined: changing a manual completion marker could replace notes/confidence/self-report metadata or assessment history, or carry an obsolete completion timestamp into a reopened lesson.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The candidate rereads and spreads the existing record before overriding the bounded status/timestamp fields; the repository preserves ID and creation time. Reopening explicitly clears completedAt and recompleting creates a fresh time while retaining startedAt. Independent route regressions passed exact progress-field, assessment/bookmark, programme and reward preservation assertions. No unresolved defect found in the scoped change.

Independent GitHub/Vercel inspection confirms the PR #68 baseline merge, passing master job and production alias, while the follow-up record explicitly leaves its own review/certification/deployment pending.
